text.text: Plan the week of moves from one page. Quotes and bookings are on the Moves board, crew leads see their own list under Mine, and Mark done closes a move after the final walk-through. Supplies shows what to reorder; Invoices tracks final payments.

Moves

Invoices

Moves by status, revenue by type of move and unpaid invoices.
Overdue moves
My moves
Overdue invoices
A good quote is based on a real inventory, not a guess.
Steps
Ask for a room-by-room inventory or do a video walkthrough.
Note stairs, elevators, parking and long carries.
Price crew hours, truck time and materials.
Add a quote range, not a single number, and explain what changes it.
Following up
Call the customer two days later. Most jobs are won by the second call.
Move day goes smoothly when everyone knows the plan before the truck leaves.
At the shop
Crew lead reviews the move sheet.
Load pads, straps, dollies and boxes.
Check the truck fuel and tires.
At the home
Walk through with the customer and point out fragile items.
Protect floors and doorways.
Load heaviest first and label rooms at the destination.
At the end
Walk the empty home with the customer, check every closet, then collect the signature on the final sheet.
Damage happens. Handling it well keeps the customer.
Steps
Photograph the item and the packing around it.
Ask the customer to describe it in writing.
Review with the owner within two business days.
Repair, replace or settle, and note it on the move.
Prevention
Wrap every item, never stack boxes over a fragile top, and use two people for anything awkward.
